Call to Order

PUBLIC PARTICIPATION
(Person/Group shall be allowed to speak without interruption up to five (5) minutes maximum time, subject to compliance with applicable meeting rules. Questions to the speaker or responses to the speaker's
questions or comments shall be handled after the speaker has completed his/her comments. Public Participation will be limited to sixty (60) minutes time.)
B.
UTILITIES DIRECTOR COMMENTS
C.
UTILITY BOARD MEMBER COMMENTS
D.
SCHEDULED ITEMS
1.
None
E.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The Consent Calendar adopting the printed recommended actions will be enacted with one vote. If Councilmembers or Staff wish to address any item on the Consent Calendar
individually, it will be considered under SPECIAL CALL ITEMS.
1.
Minutes of the Regular Utility Board Meeting on October 28, 2019 Recommendation: 1) Approve Minutes as Written.
E-1.1. Minutes of the Regular Utility Board Meeting on October 28, 2019
2.
Approval of Amendment to Transmission Control Agreement (TCA) Among the California Independent System Operator (CAISO) and the Participating Transmission Owners ("PTOs") Recommendation: 1) Approve the Amendment to Transmission Control Agreement among the CAISO and the PTOs; and 2) Authorize the Mayor, in a form acceptable to the City Attorney, to execute the Amendment to Transmission Control Agreement among the CAISO and the PTOs.
E-2.1. Approval of Amendment to Transmission Control Agreement
E-2.2. Amendment to TCA and Signature Pages
3.
Approve the Notice of Completion for the Citrus Ave and Foothill Blvd 830 Water Tie-In Capital Improvement Project W-347 Recommendation: 1) Accept Citrus Ave and Foothill Blvd 830 Water Tie-In project improvements outlined in W-347 plans and specifications; 2) Approve the Notice of Completion; 3) Authorize the Mayor to execute the document on behalf of the City; and 4) Authorize the City Clerk to submit the Notice of Completion for recordation to the Office of the County Recorder of Los Angeles County, within ten days of the Utility Board approval, as required by Section 3093 of the California Civil Code.
E-3.1. Approve the NOC for Citrus Ave and Foothill Blvd 830 Water Tie-In CIP W-347
E-3.2. Citrus-Foothill W347 NOC Form
4.
Approve First Amendment to the Professional Services Agreement with Invoice Cloud Incorporated to Provide Electronic Bill Presentment, Payment and Credit Card Processing Services Recommendation: 1) Approve the First Amendment to the Professional Services Agreement (First Amendment) with Invoice Cloud, in an amount not to exceed $175,000 annually, in accordance with Azusa Municipal Code Section 2-517(a)(22); and 2) Authorize the Mayor to execute the First Amendment, in a form acceptable to the City Attorney, on behalf of the City.
E-4.1. Approve First Amendment to PSA with Invoice Cloud
E-4.2. Invoice Cloud 1st Amendment
5.
Approve Purchase of Reservoir Mixer for the 1023 Pressure Zone to Enhance Water Quality Recommendation: 1) Approve a Purchase Order to D&H Water Systems, Inc., in an amount not-to-exceed $58,100.00 for the PAX TRS™ Trihalomethane Removal System, under Azusa Municipal Code Section 2-517(a)(35) Treatment Equipment and Section 2-520(b)(2) Sole Source Purchases.
E-5.1. Approve Purchase of Reservoir Mixer for the 1023 Pressure Zone
E-5.2. PAX THM Removal System Proposal
E-5.3. D&H Water Systems, Inc. Sole Source Letter
F.

None

ADJOURNMENT
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a city meeting, please contact the City Clerk at 626-812-5229. Notification three (3) working days prior to the meeting or time when special services are needed will assist staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide access to the meeting.
In compliance with Government Code Section 54957.5, agenda materials are available for inspection by members of the public at the following locations: Azusa City Clerk's Office - 213 E. Foothill Boulevard, Azusa City Library - 340 West Fifth Street, and Azusa Light & Water - 729 N. Azusa Avenue, Azusa CA.
